description:
QUESTIONS IN THIS SERIES ARE ONLINE QUESTIONS MOSTLY ON THE COMMENTS SECTION. 

I try to select questions the Spirit impresses me to answer. If your question is not addressed, most likely it didn't reach me or God hasn't impressed me to address it. Incase you have to ask the same question differently, please feel free to ask again and make the Word of God clear to you for the glory of God.

Here are some questions addressed in this series:

Pastor Randy, if Judas had turned away from betraying Jesus, how would the plan for his crucifixion be carried out?
Would Jesus be still taken and how? I am just trying to figure out how Jesus would be crucified if Judas did not betray him.


YOLANDA ASKED A QUESTION ABOUT LIVING WITH OTHERS

How do I [as a newly baptized member of the Adventist Church] live with an Adventist who has been in the church for years, now 84 years old, I am his caregiver….
He plays worldly radio station that he listens to… plays worldly music that disturbs my prayers….
I am praying but what more can I do?

QUESTION CONCERNING PRAYING USING ALLIGATOR PEPPER OR ROSARY

From Nigeria
I am not a member of the Adventist church but I have a question:
Is it good to pray using, “ALLIGATOR PEPPER”  as a Christian.


AMONG OTHERS....
